{{Quote|I don't think we can protect two transports at a time.|[[Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''GR-75 medium transport''', sometimes referred to as the '''Gallofree transport''', was a [[transport]] designed and constructed by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc.]]. They were lightly armed with a clamshell-like [[hull]] to protect the [[cargo pod]]s it carried. They could not reach anymore than 650 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] and had a class 4 [[hyperdrive]].

They were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] before and during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In the early [[Standard day|days]] of the rebellion, one was destroyed on a [[Massacre near Teralov|supply mission]] to [[Teralov]] and two more were destroyed in the [[Battle of Atollon]]. At least ten transports served at the [[Battle of Scarif]], and later in the war thirty served as escape craft during a partially successful attempt to evacuate rebel forces from an [[Battle of Hoth|assault]] on [[Hoth]], in which thirteen were able to escape. At least sixteen also participated in the decisive [[Battle of Endor]]. Many GR-75 transports served in the [[Battle of Jakku]], and by the [[time]] of the [[Cold War]], several GR-75 medium transports were in the service of [[Jinata Security]], which were modified with additional [[laser]] [[cannon]]s.

==Characteristics==
[[File:RebelTransport-Fathead.png|thumb|left|250px|An aft view showing the engines of a GR-75 transport]]
GR-75 medium transports, sometimes referred to as Gallofree transports, were dedicated [[transport]]s built by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] at a length of ninety [[meter]]s.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> Equipped with a class 4 [[hyperdrive]] and a class 15 backup<ref name="SS" /> they were able to reach speeds of 650 [[Kilometer per hour|KPH]].<ref name="SW EOSAOV" /> The defenses of a GR-75 transport consisted of both [[deflector shield]]s,<ref name="UltimateSW" /> but the [[GR-75 Combat Retrofit]] program subsidized by Gallofree Yards meant four<ref name="SS" /> twin [[laser cannon]]s<ref name="Rebel Files" /> could be added. Unlike the more protective dorsal [[armor]], the cargo pods and their containment fields offered little protection for the transport's internal systems.<ref name="SS" />

GR-75 transports had a clamshell-like [[durasteel]] [[hull]] consisting of a central spar and keel.<ref name="SS" /> They could carry up to 19,000 [[metric ton]]s,<ref name="SW EOSAOV" /> 1,000 more as encumbrance, of [[cargo pod]]s which are held in place by heavy magnetic shields. Other than cargo, livestock and passenger could also be carried in [[ray shield]]ed pods.<ref name="SS" /> The transport was controlled from a small [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] situated towards the rear of the craft,<ref name="Antilles Extraction">{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}}</ref> and it had seven [[sublight engine]]s at its rear.<ref name="Episode V" /> The average crew of a GR-75 transport consisted of a [[pilot]] and co-pilot, an [[engineer]], a cargo master and three more crew members.<ref name="SS" />

==Role==
{{Quote|The heavy transport ships will leave as soon as they're loaded.|Leia Organa, during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Episode V" />}}
[[File:GR75Transport-MF45.png|thumb|250px|right|The GR-75 transport was a commonly used bulk freighter throughout the galaxy.]]
GR-75 transports were used for both military and commercial purposes and were common among bulk [[freighter]]s in [[Hyperspace route|spacelanes]]. Military or paramilitary organizations occasionally used them for evacuation or underway replenishment purposes.<ref name="SS" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] incorporated many into their growing [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] as medical ships, fireships, communications ships, rescue ships, resupply ships and troop transports.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> It was principle for the transports to be kept at the rear in battle as they were too slow and weakly armored for frontline engagements. Combat retrofits could be used to draw fire from the enemies, much to the concern of their [[captain]]s.<ref name="SS" /> The [[Jinata Security]] similarly used more armed variants as escorts during the [[Cold War]].<ref name="Battlefront II" />

==History==
===Early service with the rebellion===
{{Quote|Transport to Imperial fighters: stand down! We are unarmed! You have no right to fire on us!|A GR-75 transport surrenders at Teralov|<ref name="Antilles Extraction" />}}
The GR-75 medium transport was designed and built by Gallofree Yards, Inc.<ref name="UltimateSW" /> It was designed similarly to the older [[GR-45 medium transport]].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Gallofree Yards went bankrupt and was taken over by [[Kuat Drive Yards]] by [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Last Jedi Cross-sections">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

Following the [[blockade of Ibaar]], the fugitive [[Mon Calamari]] [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] sent a document written by his [[aide]]s, [[Caitken]] and [[Shollan]], to [[Mon Mothma]], leader of one of the leading [[Mon Mothma's rebel cell|rebel cells]], about the current status of the starships part of the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]]. It had details of the fleet's major composition, including GR-75 transports as well as [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigates]], [[CR90 corvette]]s, [[CR70 corvette]]s, [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]], and [[Braha'tok-class gunship|''Braha'tok''-class gunships]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

[[File:GreenSquadron_Awings_GR75_Teralov.png|thumb|left|250px|Green Squadron escorts a GR-75 transport]]
A while later, [[Phoenix Cell]], one of the early rebel groups against the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]], used these one of these transports on a mercy mission to the [[planet]] [[Teralov]], and was escorted by [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]]. However, they were [[Massacre near Teralov|ambushed]] by an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] which deployed [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE interceptors]] to fight the rebels. The [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] [[starfighter]]s of Green squadron engaged the TIEs but were quickly picked off one by one. Once Green squadron were wiped out, the TIEs then destroyed the transport despite its surrender.<ref name="Antilles Extraction" />

In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Mon Mothma declared the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|formation]] of the Rebel Alliance, to unite the rebel cells against the Empire. As a result, a [[fleet]] of rebel [[starship]]s traveled to her location at [[Dantooine]]. Two GR-75 transports were among the vessels that rendezvoused there following the speech.<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref>

[[File:GR-75_combat_retrofit.jpg|thumb|right|250px|GR-75 Combat Retrofits were common in the Rebellion.]]
Shortly after, two GR-75 transports were stationed with [[Phoenix Cell]] above the planet [[Atollon]] as they amassed with a portion of the larger rebel cell known as the [[Massassi Group]]. Intending to launch an assault on the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE defender]] project on [[Lothal]], their plan was foiled by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]], who was able to locate the rebels as well. Before the two cells were able to travel to Lothal, the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]], led by Thrawn, [[Battle of Atollon|ambushed]] them. Although the rebels tried to break the [[blockade]], they lost a great deal of their starships in the process. Following the loss of both of their [[flagship]]s, the remaining of the cells, including the two GR-75s, were forced to retreat back to Phoenix Cell's [[Chopper Base|base]] on the surface of Atollon.<ref name="Zero Hour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>

The rebel starships hid under the cover of Chopper base, the headquarters of Phoenix Cell, and its shield. After a brief bombardment on the shield, Thrawn sent his ground forces down to defeat the rebels. In the ensuing fight, the remaining rebel forces found themselves overwhelmed and the shield was soon destroyed. One GR-75 transport tried to escape but was shot down and destroyed by Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s. Other rebel forces were soon able to escape the base and run the blockade above, but without the final GR-75.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|The ''energy shield'' can only be open for a ''short time''. So you'll have to stay ''very'' close to your transports.|Leia Organa, during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Episode V" />}}
[[File:Rebel_Fleet_above_Scarif.jpg|thumb|left|250px|GR-75 transports participated in the Battle of Scarif]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> at least twelve GR-75 transports traveled to [[Scarif]] with Admiral Raddus to [[Battle of Scarif|assist]] ground forces who were trying to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] the Empire's new [[superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. While fighting above the now closed [[Shield Gate]], [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] ravaged a GR-75 during their attack run on the fleet. Once the Death Star plans had been sent to the rebel flagship, the ''[[Profundity]]'', Raddus ordered the fleet to escape. As the rebel ships began jumping into [[hyperspace]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' arrived and cut them off. One GR-75 was too close to the Star Destroyer to avoid it and almost immediately crashed into it. Other GR-75 transports that had also been cut off avoid the volley of [[turbolaser]] firing on the ''Profundity''.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Yavin]], a GR-75 transport traveled with a large number of ships to [[Espirion]] to help [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Leia IV">[[Princess Leia 4|''Princess Leia'' 4]]</ref> More of them were with the rebel fleet when Mon Mothma, Admiral [[Gial Ackbar]] and [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] received a distress call from the [[droid]] [[R2-D2]].<ref name="SW9">[[Star Wars (2015) 9|''Star Wars'' (2015) 9]]</ref> Another was present when Organa left the rebel fleet for [[Vrogas Vas]].<ref name="Vader Down I">[[Vader Down 1|''Vader Down'' 1]]</ref> One helped evacuate [[Sunspot Prison]] following a [[Prison siege at Sunspot|massacre]] there.<ref name="SW19">[[Star Wars (2015) 19|''Star Wars'' (2015) 19]]</ref> A GR-75 was traveling in concert with an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] before the [[Siege on Tureen VII]].<ref name="SW23">[[Star Wars (2015) 23|''Star Wars'' (2015) 23]]</ref> Following an [[attack on the Rebel Fleet]], GR-75 transports landed on the surface of [[Baraan-Fa]] while the Organa and Mothma discussed having new rebel base. As a result, Organa [[Mission to Crait|traveled]] to [[Crait]] aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' with a GR-75.<ref name="Storms of Crait">[[The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait 1|''The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait'' 1]]</ref>

[[File:DarthVader2020-2-Sprouse-textless.png|thumb|right|250px|GR-75 transports escaped the besiegement of Hoth.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> thirty GR-75 transports were stationed at the Alliance's [[Echo Base|secret base]] on [[Hoth]]. After an Imperial [[probe droid]] discovered the rebel presence there, [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] traveled there with his fleet, [[Death Squadron]]. The rebels began evacuating, assigning two [[X-wing starfighter]]s as escort to each GR-75.<ref name="Episode V" /> The ''[[Quantum Storm]]'' left first, under the cover of the rebels' [[V-150 Planet Defender]]. The ''[[Thon's Orchard]]'' and ''[[Dutyfree]]'' also escaped Hoth.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> The final transport to leave was the ''[[Bright Hope]]'', which was meant to have Organa aboard before she was cut off from reaching it by a tunnel blockage.<ref name="Episode V" /> By the time it had escaped, seventeen of the transports had been destroyed.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> After, several GR-75 transports were stationed at the [[Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine]], where [[Luke Skywalker]] received a new [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] hand inside the Nebulon-B frigate ''[[Redemption]]''.<ref name="Episode V" /> One GR-75 served as a mobile [[rebel recruitment base]].<ref name="TIE Fighter 5">[[TIE Fighter 5|''TIE Fighter'' 5]]</ref>

In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> the Alliance fleet amassed near [[Sullust]] in preparation to attack the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]]. At least sixteen GR-75 transports were among the starships present. They soon traveled to the [[Endor system]] to begin their assault, but were ambushed by Death Squadron. However, in a turn of events, rebel starfighters were able to fly into the Death Star via its exhaust ports and destroy it.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Following the [[Battle of Cawa City]] seventeen days after, GR-75 transports were stationed with the rebel flagship ''[[Home One]]'' at [[Muster Point: Vergence]]. An additional GR-75 carrying [[Shara Bey]] and a number of other rebels arrived and docked into the flagship.<ref name="Shattered Empire II">[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]]</ref> The fleet, still including GR-75 transports was later at [[Muster Point: Stalwart]].<ref name="Shattered Empire IV">[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]]</ref> By [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the Alliance, now the [[New Republic]], had chased remaining loyalist forces of the Empire to [[Jakku]]. The [[New Republic Defense Fleet]], including GR-75 transports, [[Battle of Jakku|engaged]] the Empire in an assault that claimed some of the GR-75s present. Nevertheless, the New Republic won, and the Empire [[Galactic Concordance|surrendered]] shortly after.<ref name="Battlefront" />

===Cold War===
{{Quote|I'm picking up starfighters and transports.|[[Zay Versio]], to Iden Versio|<ref name="Battlefront II" />}}
[[File:NewRepublicVolunteers-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|The New Republic continued to use GR-75 medium transports for transporting supplies.]]
After the Galactic Civil War, groups within the New Republic continued to use the GR-75 for aid and supply missions. At least one of these GR-75s was painted with several [[Color|blue]] markings, and was present above [[Hosnian Prime]] while it was escorted by a trio of [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]s.<ref name="New Republic Volunteers">{{FFGXW2|set=Huge Ship Conversion Kit|cardname=New Republic Volunteers}}</ref> During the [[Cold War]], the Jinata Security used modified GR-75 transports which were equipped with additional laser cannons. Three escorted the Nebulon-B frigate [[Opportunity (Nebulon-B)|''Opportunity'']] when it [[Mission to Athulla|engaged]] [[Iden Versio]] and the [[Corvus (Raider II-class)|''Corvus'']] above [[Athulla]]. They were destroyed by Versio's X-wing.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> GR-75 transports were part of a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to assist the Resistance during the [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] over the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|These were called "tuna ships" in production, and the actual model has a bit of a pink cast to it.|Pablo Hidalgo, on the GR-75 transport|<ref name="Tuna ship tweet">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/921603214218215424|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Since people seem interested. These were called "tuna ships" in production, and the actual model has a bit of a pink cast to it.|nobackup=1}}</ref>}}
The GR-75 transport first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Episode V" /> ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', published on [[April 28]], [[2015]], identifies it as the GR-75 transport,<ref name="UltimateSW" /> but the official [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry lists it as a "GR-75 medium transport."<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|gr-75-medium-transport|GR-75 Medium Transport}}</ref> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the ship was identified by the [[2004]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', written by [[James Luceno]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="IWSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

During production of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', the GR-75 transports were nicknamed "tuna ships," and the model had a slight pink cast.<ref name="Tuna ship tweet" /> Despite being transports, they were included in the battle scenes of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] because more ships were needed, but no [[in-universe]] explanation of their presence has been given.<ref name="GR75 in ROTJ tweet">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/921572819951001600|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=The only "real" answer is because the ESB model existed and ROTJ needed ships. Anything in-universe hasn't been said.|nobackup=1}}</ref>
